case_name: Urban Money Pvt Ltd vs Ojascoworking Pvt Ltd
facts_of_case: Parties entered into a Lease Agreement dated 27.12.2021 with an arbitration clause. Disputes arose, and the petitioner invoked arbitration vide notice dated 01.02.2023.

legal_principles.principle: A party is deemed to be served if the respondent has been served by way of email as well as speed post and there is no bounce back.
legal_principles.held: He submits that as per the tracking report, the respondent has been served and even the e-mail sent to the respondent has not bounced back.
cited_cases: Urban Money Pvt Ltd vs Ojascoworking Pvt Ltd on 14 September, 2023

legal_principles.principle: A party's registered address and email can be verified through the MCA website.
legal_principles.held: He further submits that in terms of this Court's directions dated 15.05.2023, the MCA website was checked and the registered address as well as the e-mail were found to be the same.
cited_cases: Urban Money Pvt Ltd vs Ojascoworking Pvt Ltd on 14 September, 2023

outcome.final_order: Disputes between parties referred to arbitral tribunal; Mr. Divyam Nandrajog appointed as sole arbitrator; arbitration held under Delhi International Arbitration Centre.

use_for_drafting: using QR codes in court orders
